Practical Experience on the Plant Floor

Industrial Networks & Plant Connectivity

Hands-on experience with plant networks, PRP redundancy, and HMI/PLC networking and installation. We help teams connect equipment, understand their network, and maintain clear records for troubleshooting and future changes.

Plant Network Installation & Troubleshooting

Plan and install agreed network equipment and connections for production areas. Investigate communication problems and document the installed network so maintenance teams have a clear starting point.

PRP Network Redundancy

Support Parallel Redundancy Protocol (PRP) network installation and review. Check the agreed equipment and separate network paths, document the topology, and plan validation with the plant team.

HMI & PLC Networking

Connect operator interfaces and controllers to the plant network, verify agreed communication paths, and troubleshoot network connectivity during installation or equipment changes.

Network Documentation & Handover

Provide agreed network drawings, device and connection records, and practical handover instructions for maintenance and operations teams.
